name: Sahil Hussain
heroLine: I turn raw spreadsheets into decisions people can act on.
heroSub: Building dashboards, automations and reporting systems that keep businesses moving.

about.heading: I'm Sahil
paragraphs: Experienced Data Analyst with a passion for continuous learning and delivering data-driven insights. Skilled in identifying trends, resolving technical issues, and guiding users across a wide range of software systems. Proficient in Excel, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Power BI and SQL, with expertise in building interactive dashboards and managing automated reporting workflows.

With a strong background in MIS (Management Information Systems), I specialise in building and managing Business Intelligence dashboards that support operational and strategic decision-making. My experience includes automating complex processes using Google Apps Script, and integrating tools to streamline workflows such as Checklists, FMS, Delegation systems, IMS and Project Management Systems.
I thrive in dynamic environments where analytical thinking, automation and system improvement intersect — always eager to learn, adapt and contribute to data-led growth.
